'''Volume 1''' is the first of four omnibus volumes of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. It was published by [[Shogakukan Asia]] in {{pmin|Singapore}}, although it uses [[VIZ Media]]'s translation. This volume contains all the chapters found in {{PAV|15}} and {{PAV|16}} (excluding [[PS180]], which is part of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}).

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{Adv|Ruby}} moves from [[Johto]] to [[Littleroot Town]] in [[Hoenn]].
* Ruby meets [[Professor Birch]].
* Ruby meets {{Adv|Sapphire}}.
* Ruby and Sapphire make a bet to see who can beat their [[Ribbon|respective]] [[Badge|goals]] in eighty days.
* Norman is informed of Ruby's running away and decides to search for his son.
* {{Adv|Sapphire}} goes on her journey to challenge the Hoenn's Gyms.
* {{Adv|Ruby}} meets {{adv|Wally}}.
* Ruby helps Wally capture his first Pokémon, a {{p|Kecleon}}.
* Ruby is swept out to sea after an earthquake and loses his {{p|Ralts}}. This Ralts is later found by {{adv|Wally}}.
* {{adv|Sapphire}} defeats [[Team Aqua]], but they successfully steal the [[Devon Parts|Devon Goods]].
* [[Mr. Stone]] gives {{adv|Sapphire}} a letter for {{Steven}}.
* {{Adv|Ruby}} is rescued by [[Mr. Briney]] at sea.
* {{Adv|Sapphire}} leaves to [[Dewford Town]].
* {{Adv|Ruby}} wakes up on [[Mr. Briney]]'s boat.
* Sapphire and Ruby meet up once again at Dewford.
* Ruby meets [[Steven Stone]].
* Ruby and Sapphire reach the [[Abandoned Ship]].
* Sapphire and Ruby battle against [[Courtney]] and [[Tabitha]].
* Courtney and Tabitha get away with the Detector.
* Ruby and Sapphire go their separate ways.
* Ruby lures [[Blaise]] onto the Submarine Explorer 1.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
* {{Adv|Ruby}} captures {{p|Mudkip}} ([[Mumu]]) in [[PS183]].
* {{Adv|Wally}} decides to take care of [[Rara]], Ruby's {{p|Ralts}}, until they meet again.

===Evolutions===
* [[Chic]] evolves into {{p|Combusken}} in [[PS195]].
* [[Rono]] evolves into {{p|Lairon}} in [[PS195]].
* [[Kiki]] evolves into {{p|Delcatty}} in [[PS196]].
* [[Nana]] evolves into {{p|Mightyena}} in [[PS196]].
* [[Mumu]] evolves into {{p|Marshtomp}} in [[PS200]].

==Gym battles==
* {{Adv|Sapphire}} defeats [[Roxanne]] in [[PS191]].
* Sapphire defeats [[Brawly]] in [[PS197]].
